text:
elena: Quick design sanity check on the left-rail regrouping prototype. I pushed a compact variant that collapses several admin pages under a single header. Two issues popped up with shared deep links and keyboard users. can we triage?

elena: Repro: paste /org/acme/ws/omega/reports/2025/summary -> rail expands but highlight stays on 'Reports' group instead of the '2025 summary' item. URL is correct.

matt: yep saw that. Resolver is doing a prefix-first match. it treats '/reports' as the match and never checks for the longer paramized child.

rik: quick proposal: resolution order should be exact fullPath -> paramized mapping (decode ids) -> alias redirects -> longest prefix fallback. this makes leaf routes win.

anya: Accessibility notes: when a deep link resolves to a child, the DOM focus must move to that exact link and aria-current="page" placed there. if the group had to expand, set aria-expanded on the group button and use a short aria-live announcement like "Reports expanded, 2025 summary selected."

elena: banner copy idea when fallback happens (i.e., resolved != requested): small dismissible snackbar: "Showing closest match — open original" (link). only show if user has access to original item. otherwise silently canonicalize.

matt: implementation detail: keep aliasMap in the nav manifest in the UI repo. runtime can fetch manifest and apply patches via feature flag. helps with rollouts.

rik: canonicalization: use history.replaceState to set the canonical resolved path, but preserve the ability to go back to the original external link. approach: push an ephemeral entry for the original then replace with resolved, so back returns to external referrer. pseudocode:
```
const orig = normalize(location.href);
const resolved = resolve(orig);
if (resolved !== orig) {
  history.pushState({via: 'orig'}, '', orig); // back target
  history.replaceState({}, '', resolved); // canonical
  showBannerOnce('Showing closest match — Open original', {href: orig});
} else {
  history.replaceState({}, '', resolved);
}
```

anya: Banner a11y: give it role="status" and aria-live="polite"; link should be focusable and have aria-label that includes the original path. store dismissed banners in sessionStorage keyed by orig to avoid repeat nags.

elena: normalizer rules I sketched: strip hash anchors, remove trailing slash, decode percent-encoding, lowercase segments (except ids), stable-sort query keys except utm_/auth tokens.

matt: dev question: how do we detect slug collisions where a group slug equals an item id? e.g., /overview used by both. we should prefer exact paramized item when segments match a resource pattern. also add unit tests for ambiguous patterns.

rik: agree. resolver should test param patterns first if the segment count equals expected child depth. fall back to prefix otherwise. add logging when collisions occur so we can clean up nav manifest.

anya: keyboard UX: when user uses the hotkey to focus nav, the focus should land on the highlighted item. if the item was revealed by expansion, animate a gentle fade-in on the highlight to reduce jarring focus jumps. ensure animation is brief and doesn't interfere with screen readers.

elena: copy nits: prefer "Showing closest match" to be concise. CTA: "Open original". Keep banner small and non-modal.

matt: Preview: https://console-preview.redwood/nav/rail-compact (ephemeral). Added a toggle to test collisions.

rik: QA checklist: deep-link highlight, history back behavior, aria-current placement, aria-expanded announcements, banner show/hide logic, canonical replaceState, slug collision unit tests, focus animation timing.

anya: Action items: @matt update resolver PR to exact->params->aliases->prefix + add tests; @rik prototype push/replace history behavior and demo; @anya will paste small ARIA snippets for devs; @elena will upload compact vs expanded mocks to figma. sync Weds 10:30.

nav-bot: Deployed preview build: https://playground.redwood/nav/rail-compact-2198 (note: ephemeral)

elena: thanks all :thumbsup:"
